notes: Each eval runs against a fresh copy of negotiation_agent/examples/Negotiation Pairing Solution. Eval 3 needs a recorded Used Car 2026-10-14 pairing for Section 01 (pair --seed 11 with Mateo Flores absent, record, mailmerge) plus Survey Export.csv from examples/test_tools/make_fake_survey.py. The instructor's answers to checkpoint questions are given in each prompt, because the instructor is not available during automated runs.

evals.name: pair-with-absences
evals.prompt: Pair Fall 2026 Section 01 for the Used Car negotiation on 10/14 (2026). Mateo Flores, Katie Nguyen, and Alex are out. Then get the role emails ready. [Instructor answers: 'Alex' means Alex Kim; 'Katie Nguyen' is Katherine Nguyen; approve as-is if there are no repeat partners; accept role-balance warnings.]
evals.expected_output: 22 students in 11 Buyer/Seller pairs with no repeat partners; Mateo, Katherine, Alex Kim, Rohan Patel (dropped) and Liam Brennan (no ID) not paired; new pair ID and role columns added to Pairing History after a backup; Role Mail Merge workbook with 22 rows; instructor told Chidi Okafor has no email.
assertions: Pairing recorded in Pairing History as a new pair-ID column
Existing Pairing History cells left unchanged
Pairing History backed up before writing
22 students paired, each exactly once
Absent, dropped, and no-ID students are not paired
No repeat partners from earlier negotiations
All groups are pairs
